jobs.title: Project Coordinator - Operations
jobs.description:
The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

**Position Purpose and Summary**

Every repair, vendor visit, permit renewal, and vehicle inspection at HTM begins as a request that someone has to receive, route, and follow through on until it is closed. The Operations Coordinator is that person.

Reporting to the Director of Operations, the Project Coordinator - Operations serves as the intake, dispatch, and coordination point for the Operations Department across Facilities and Maintenance, Safety, IT, Fleet Management, and Warehouse and Delivery Logistics. This role monitors and triages the MaintainX queue and assigns work to the appropriate staff member or approved vendor; maintains the departmental compliance calendar for licenses, permits, inspections, and fleet records; solicits quotes and issues purchase requests within assigned thresholds; reconciles vendor invoices; and compiles the reporting that department and senior leadership rely on. The Operations Coordinator supports both the Director of Operations and the Operations Manager.

Operations is a department where the cost of a dropped request is measured in a shelter without hot water or a van that cannot make a food run. The Operations Coordinator exists so that requests are not dropped, deadlines are not missed, and no repair, renewal, or inspection depends on someone remembering it. This is not clerical work performed in service of a department. It is the mechanism by which the department keeps its commitments.

**Responsibilities**

***Request Intake and Dispatch***

* Monitor the MaintainX queue and all Operations request channels throughout the workday. Log, categorize, and assign priority to every incoming request.
* Dispatch requests to the appropriate Facilities, Maintenance, Safety, IT, or Fleet staff member, or to an approved vendor, based on trade, site location, and urgency.
* Acknowledge every incoming request within the departmental 24-hour response standard. Confirm receipt to the requesting site and communicate an estimated response time.
* Redistribute open work when a staff member is unavailable or a site escalates. Notify the Director of Operations or Operations Leadership of any request that cannot be assigned within standard.
* Track open tickets through to closure. Follow up on aging work orders and escalate any request that exceeds the established resolution window.
* Recognize matters that require management judgment rather than routine routing, and escalate them promptly rather than resolving them independently.

***Vendor and Purchasing Coordination***

* Solicit and collect quotes from approved vendors. Assemble comparison documentation for the Director of Operations or Operations Manager where multiple quotes are required.
* Issue purchase requests and work orders to approved vendors within assigned dollar thresholds. Route any request exceeding the assigned threshold, or involving a vendor not on the approved list, to the Director of Operations for approval before any commitment is made.
* Schedule vendor site visits, service calls, and preventive maintenance appointments. Confirm site access and notify site leadership in advance.
* Maintain the vendor file including W-9s, certificates of insurance, business licenses, signed agreements, and contact records. Track expiration dates and request renewals before coverage or credentials lapse.
* Reconcile vendor invoices against work performed and approved quotes. Flag discrepancies to the Director of Operations before invoices are submitted for payment.

***Compliance Documentation and Tracking***

* Maintain the Operations compliance calendar covering facility licenses, permits, regulatory inspections, fire and life safety certifications, and DPH requirements. Issue advance notice of upcoming renewals and expirations.
* Assemble compliance documentation for audits, monitoring visits, and funder or regulatory requests.

***Reporting and Records***

* Maintain the departmental filing structure so that records are current, organized, complete, and retrievable.
* Prepare agendas, materials, and meeting notes for departmental meetings as directed.
* Provide status information to sites and internal departments on ticket status, repairs, and estimated response times.

***New Site Setup and Demobilization***

* Maintain the new site operational readiness checklist. Track the status of each item and report progress to the Director of Operations.
* Open and coordinate utility accounts, waste service, pest control, alarm monitoring, and recurring service contracts.
* Coordinate delivery and installation scheduling for furniture, equipment, and technology.
* Support demobilization logistics including account closure, equipment recovery, and record retention.

***Secondary Duties and Responsibilities***

* Provide administrative and scheduling support to the Director of Operations and the Operations Leadership.
* Maintain inventory of departmental supplies, keys, access credentials, and assigned equipment.
* Participate in departmental and organizational meetings, training, and committees as assigned.
* Additional tasks, projects, and responsibilities as assigned by the Director of Operations.
* This position requires occasional travel to multiple HTM locations. Travel percentage: 15%

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in business administration, operations management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum two years of administrative, coordination, dispatch, or operations support experience required.
* Experience with work order or ticketing systems, vendor coordination, or compliance record keeping strongly preferred.
* Prior experience supporting a multi-site organization preferred.
* CalOSHA 10 Certification required; or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

* Manages

Alpha Analytical Laboratories, Inc. is a full-service environmental testing laboratory network. We’ve served California since 1975 and run six ELAP-accredited labs across the state. We also test for agencies that enforce permits, including the EPA, the State Water Resources Control Board, and county and city agencies.

Our Southern California lab in Signal Hill is growing. We’re looking for an organized, dependable team member to run sample control and support client project coordination.

* Assemble sampling kits for clients and for field staff and couriers

jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self-reliance and personal growth.  
  
Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project-access.org/success-stories/

**The opportunity**

The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

**What you'll do**

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth & Families, Health & Wellness, and Community Building.
* Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
* Coordinate and oversee an after-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
* Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
* Develop & maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
* Plan & facilitate community-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
* Provide residents with information & referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
* Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
* Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door-to-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high-traffic locations.
* Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
* Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
* Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
* Collect & submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
* Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.

**What you'll bring**

* Four years of experience in multi-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
* Minimum of one year experience in both:
* + after-school programs or educational settings for youth
* + serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness.
* Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
* Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
* Self-starter, multi-tasker, and strong communicator
* The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.

**Credentials/Certifications**

* Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance

The Social Media Coordinator is responsible for managing consumer content and engagement on JMM’s social platforms ensuring consistent, relevant and exceptional consumer engagement. This role is pivotal in shaping the brand’s image and engaging with our audience in a meaningful way. This role required a mix of creativity, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of social media dynamics. The Social Media Coordinator works on-site in our West Hollywood HQ and reports to the Head of Brand.

* Plan and execute marketing campaigns on instagram and relevant platforms; including collaborations, new collections, and launches.
* Explore and implement innovative social media strategies.
* Optimize and amplify the brand’s presence/voice on existing social media platforms

**Key Requirements**

* Proven social media management skills, preferably in the luxury or fashion industry.
* Strong creative and visual skills with proficiency in content creation tools.
* In-depth knowledge of Instagram trends, features, and algorithms.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze and interpret social media metrics

We promote initiatives aimed at supporting professional equality for everyone. We strive to go above and beyond purely symbolic measures by building a culture focused on meaningful strategies aimed at creating an inclusive workforce.

**Role Purpose:**

The Paid Media Coordinator is a core support and execution-focused role within the Media team. The primary function is to assist the daily operational, tactical, and administrative requirements of media campaigns across content creators, endemic media, self-serve, auction-based platforms (primarily Google, and paid social). This position is responsible for ensuring the accurate setup, proper pacing, consistent monitoring, and quality assurance of campaign delivery, providing critical support to Senior Planners and Supervisors. This position is a three month contract with an opportunity to be transitioned to a full time role.

### **Core Functions and Responsibilities:**

The duties of this position are divided into four primary functional areas:

#### **1. Campaign Setup and Stewardship (40%)**

This function ensures the technical accuracy and continuous delivery of all live campaigns, as well as necessary administrative documentation.

* **Setup & QA:** Execute the complete technical setup of campaigns, including the accurate configuration of pixels, UTM tracking, creative uploads, ad creation, and trafficking for both Google, endemic media and paid social platforms.
* **Tracking Management:** Generate, compile, and QA all necessary UTM tracking links required for approved media plans.
* **Pacing & Delivery:** Conduct mandatory weekly (or as needed) checks on campaign pacing and delivery. Identify and proactively flag any under/over-delivery risks or budget discrepancies to the Supervisor/Planner.
* **Operational Coordination:** Liaise with Planners to maintain an updated tracking log of all pending materials (creative assets, ad copy, landing page URLs, client approval) required for campaign launch or maintenance.
* **Financial & Project System Support:** Assist the team with updating and maintaining internal financial tracking and project management systems to ensure accurate record-keeping of budgets, deliverables, and timelines.
* **Billing Support:** Assist the Media Planners/Director with monthly account reconciliation processes for media spend and documentation.
* **Data Contribution:** Gather and organize campaign performance data points to contribute to both internal performance reviews and external client reporting decks.

#### **2. Paid Social Execution Support (30%)**

This function supports the implementation and maintenance of biddable social campaigns.

* **Campaign Execution:** Implement and manage campaign settings and biddable formats across platforms (Meta, X, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit) to align with client goals (e.g., engagement, acquisition, awareness) as directed by the supervising Planner.
* **Audience Research:** Conduct and compile initial research on targeting parameters, audience segments, and competitor activity to support strategic planning phases.
* **Optimization Support:** Under supervision, perform routine campaign optimizations, including minor bid adjustments, budget shifts, and testing of new ad copy/creative within active campaigns.

#### **3. Influencer Execution Support (30%)**

This function supports the implementation and maintenance of influencer campaigns.

* **Identification & Outreach:** Assist in identifying, vetting, and coordinating outreach to relevant influencers and content creators based on audience demographics, brand alignment, and campaign goals.
* **Continued Communications:** Manage day-to-day communication with influencers and creator partners, including deliverable requirements, contracts, content timelines, posting schedules, tracking links, and campaign expectations.
* **Performance Review:** Monitor influencer campaign performance metrics, including reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, and conversions, flagging any significant deviations from campaign goals.

* **MarTech Stack:** Maintain working knowledge of the internal technology stack required for campaign execution, including budget management systems, data visualization tools, and ad verification platforms.
* **Measurement & Tagging:** Support the team by executing and validating third-party tracking implementation, including **Google Campaign Manager 360 (GCM) tagging and reporting** functionality.
* **Professional Development:** Proactively pursue necessary platform certifications (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Blueprint) and attend internal training sessions to ensure skills remain current with rapidly evolving media technologies.
* **Process Improvement:** Participate in internal meetings to share observations on operational efficiencies and contribute to the refinement of campaign setup and QA protocols.

We are the only luxury marketing platform that unites data and performance, content and creativity, experiences and communications within one integrated ecosystem.

**About our** **Strategic Communications** **Division:**

In the Strategic Communications Division, we are the global partners for brands that define categories. Our expertise is singular: integrated communications for luxury, ultra-luxury, and lifestyle.

In this role, you'll own the planning and execution of high-impact events and field marketing programs, including major cybersecurity conferences, industry summits, trade shows, executive roundtables, customer gatherings, and regional experiences. You'll work closely with Marketing, Sales, executive leadership, and external partners to create memorable experiences that strengthen relationships, build brand awareness, and contribute to measurable pipeline growth.

We're looking for someone who combines **strong event management expertise with a strategic, business-minded approach to field marketing**. You should be comfortable managing every aspect of an event, from initial planning and budgeting to onsite execution and post-event follow-up, while understanding how each initiative supports broader marketing and revenue objectives.

This is a role with real ownership and autonomy. We value people who bring fresh ideas, take initiative, work independently, and find smarter ways to get things done.

### **Experience We're Looking For:**

* 10+ years of professional experience, including 3–5+ years owning B2B events end to end, from strategy, budget, and vendor selection through onsite execution and post-event pipeline follow-up, ideally within cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology.

jobs.description:
**ROOFCORP of America, Inc.**

Sales Coordinator Commercial Roofing | Anaheim, California Full-time, on-site | Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM | No nights, no weekends

**ABOUT ROOFCORP OF AMERICA**

We have been repairing, restoring, and replacing commercial flat roofs since 1985. We specialize in TPO, built-up roofing, and silicone restoration for building owners and property managers across California, Oregon, Washington, and Alaska. We are a family-run company with more than 40 years in business and offices in Anaheim, Seattle, and Bogotá, Colombia. Many of our people have been with us for twenty years or more. We operate on a simple standard: do honest work, do it right, and take care of the customer. Quality here is personal, not a department.

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Sales Coordinator is the hub of our Pacific Southwest sales operation. Our estimators are out on roofs and our sales team is in front of customers. You are the person who makes sure nothing behind them falls through the cracks: proposals go out on time, bids are submitted before the deadline, follow-ups actually happen, and customer records stay accurate. This is a visible role with real ownership. You will work directly with our Anaheim field team, our Sales Manager in Seattle, and our back office in Bogotá. If you are organized, you like deadlines, and you take pride in catching mistakes before anyone else does, you will do well here.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Log incoming leads, service calls, and bid invitations accurately, the same day they arrive. - Build proposals and roof condition reports from estimator field notes and photos, clean, professional, and error-free before they reach a customer.

- Track the bid board: due dates, addenda, plan-room submittals, and prequalification packets. - Schedule roof inspections and estimator appointments, coordinating routes so field time is used well.

- Follow up on open proposals on a set schedule and keep the pipeline current. - Maintain customer and project records: contacts, insurance certificates, W-9s, and vendor portal registrations.

- Produce a weekly pipeline and activity report for the Sales Manager.

**REQUIREMENTS**

- Two or more years in sales coordination, project administration, estimating support, or inside sales support.

- Construction, roofing, or another skilled trade is a strong plus, but we will train the right person. - Excellent written English. Your documents go directly to building owners and property managers.

- The ability to learn new software quickly.

- Genuine attention to detail. In this seat, a wrong address or a missed deadline costs real money.

- Reliable on-site attendance, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

- An associate's degree is preferred but not required. We value hands-on experience equally.

**PREFERRED**

- Bilingual English/Spanish. - Experience with CRM systems or construction bid platforms such as BuildingConnected, iSqFt, Procore, or PlanHub.

- Experience serving commercial property management customers.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

- $28.00 – $34.00 per hour, depending on experience. Candidates with commercial roofing, bid platform, or property management experience start at the upper end of the range.

- Paid sick leave. - Paid holidays.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Please include a short note of a few sentences telling us why this role is a good fit for you. In this position, written communication matters, and we read every note. ROOFCORP of America, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.

Pay: $28.00 - $34.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

The Analyst & Project Manager works directly with senior leadership and carries each assignment from initial valuation through close of escrow.  
  
The Analyst & Project Manager executes projects across five areas:  
  

* Financial analysis
* Design
* Marketing
* AI process improvement

  
Much of the team’s analytical and production work is powered by proprietary internal technology. The person in this seat is not expected to build every model by hand or use traditional underwriting models. Instead, they:  
  

* Direct these systems
* Review every output with a critical eye
* Correct errors before anything reaches leadership or a client
* Continually engage in process improvement

  
In addition to day-to-day assignments, the successful candidate will take on projects that advance the vision of the brokerage unit, and the scope of the role will expand as the business grows.  
  
The hourly range for this role is $35.00 – $40.00 per hour. Actual pay will be determined by factors such as education, experience, and job-related skills relevant to the role. Marcus & Millichap is a multi-state employer and posted salary ranges are provided in good faith for compliance with all relevant pay-transparency regulations. These ranges may not reflect potential compensation for positions based in other states or regions.

**Responsibilities**

* Select and vet sale, lease, and on-market comparables for each assignment, and assemble the submarket data that feeds the team’s AI-powered tools. The quality of these inputs determines the quality of the valuation.
* Direct the underwriting tool through cash flow, cap rate, IRR, owner-user, land residual, and sensitivity analysis, and review each output carefully to confirm that assumptions, calculations, and conclusions are sound.
* Translate the analysis into a written pricing recommendation for leadership approval and explain and defend the reasoning behind it to senior leadership and clients.

* Serve as the quality-control checkpoint for AI-generated work, minimizing errors and ensuring every deliverable meets the team’s standard before it is released.
* Identify bottlenecks in the analysis, design, and marketing workflows, and help build and refine AI agents and automations that increase the team’s capacity and underwriting depth.

* Strong written communication and presentation skills
* An entrepreneurial mindset and a willingness to take on any task that helps build the business

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Inside Sales Representative – Pharmaceuticals & Medical Supplies

We are looking for a **highly motivated, talented, and competitive Inside Sales Representative** who wants to build a substantial book of business and be rewarded directly for the results they produce.

This is not an order-taking position. We are looking for someone who is **hungry to win, comfortable prospecting for new business, persistent in developing new accounts, and motivated by uncapped earning potential.**

Our company sells **pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and medical supplies to wholesale distributors.** You will be responsible for developing your own customer base, building long-term relationships, and turning those relationships into repeat business.

What You'll Do

You will take ownership of your territory and customer base from prospecting through ongoing account management.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Prospecting and developing new B2B accounts
* Identifying purchasing decision-makers and developing relationships with them
* Selling pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to wholesale distributors
* Learning customers' purchasing patterns, product needs, and supply challenges
* Following up consistently on quotes, opportunities, and potential orders
* Growing existing accounts through repeat business and additional product opportunities
* Maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers
* Managing your sales pipeline and staying organized with follow-ups
* Working closely with our purchasing and operations teams to identify opportunities and fulfill customer needs

As you establish a strong customer base, the position becomes increasingly relationship-driven, with more of your time focused on managing, retaining, and expanding the accounts you have developed.

Who We're Looking For

We want someone with **B2B inside sales experience** who understands that building a successful book of business takes consistent effort. Medical sales experience is a plus.

The right person is:

* Competitive and highly self-motivated
* Comfortable proactively pursuing new business
* Persistent without being discouraged by rejection
* Naturally good at building business relationships
* An excellent communicator on the phone and through email
* Organized and disciplined with follow-up
* Able to identify opportunities and move quickly
* Motivated by financial success
* Interested in building something over the long term rather than simply collecting a paycheck
* Able to work independently while also contributing to a team

Experience selling pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, healthcare products, or other B2B products is valuable, but **industry experience is not required if you have demonstrated B2B sales ability and are willing to learn.**

Compensation

This position is intentionally **commission-heavy with a smaller base salary.**

We want our salespeople to have meaningful upside when they perform. Your earning potential will be driven largely by your ability to develop accounts, generate profitable sales, and grow your book of business.

**High performers will have the opportunity to earn substantially more than they would in a traditional salary-heavy sales position.**

What Success Looks Like

In the beginning, success means **activity, persistence, and account development.** You should expect to spend significant time prospecting, contacting potential customers, and creating new relationships.

Over time, the goal is to **build a valuable book of repeat customers.**

We want our salespeople developing relationships that produce repeat orders, referrals, larger opportunities, and long-term revenue.

As your customer base grows, your role will increasingly shift from pure prospecting toward **managing and expanding the relationships you've created.**

This Position Is a Great Fit If...

You are the type of salesperson who looks at a commission plan and thinks about the upside rather than the guarantee.

You enjoy competing.

You like developing relationships but aren't afraid to pursue new business.

You want your income to increase as your skills, customer base, and sales increase.

And most importantly, **you want an opportunity where exceptional performance is rewarded.**

If you're talented, hungry, persistent, and ready to build a serious book of business in the pharmaceutical and medical supply industry, we want to hear from you.

**Apply with your resume and a brief explanation of why you believe you would excel in a high-performance B2B sales environment.**

Pay: $80,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching

* Health insurance
* On-the-job training
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Sales: 2 years (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* San Clemente, CA 92672 (Preferred)

**INNOCEAN USA**, a full-service ad agency located in sunny Huntington Beach, CA, is seeking a **Social Media Specialist** to join our **Kia** team!

We are a hybrid work environment, currently x3 days week onsite. Candidates must be local to SoCal.

**OVERVIEW**

The **Social Media Specialist** **[aka Sr Community Manager]** will support social content planning, platform strategy, creator evaluation, customer care, and performance reporting. This role connects strategy with day-to-day execution, translating audience insights, cultural trends, and performance data into clear recommendations and organized content plans.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management and attention to detail with strategic thinking, platform fluency, and an understanding of what makes content relevant to audiences.

**RESPONSIBILTIES**

**Content Planning & Partner Coordination**

* Own the development and maintenance of social content calendar briefs, calendar decks, and campaign posting decks, ensuring alignment with approved strategy, messaging, and platform best practices.
* Develop partner agency deck templates that clearly communicate strategic direction, content requirements, and delivery expectations.
* Serve as the primary contact for partner agency content delivery, managing timelines, consolidating feedback, and coordinating asset handoffs.
* Maintain accurate posting details, asset versions, and approval status across deliverables.
* Review content for platform specifications, brand consistency, accessibility, and publishing readiness.

**Platform Strategy & Optimization**

* Make strategic recommendations for platforms, formats, and content approaches based on audience insights, previous performance, emerging trends, and platform best practices.

**Creator & Influencer Support**

**Customer Care Oversight**

* Manage the customer care team’s workflow, coverage, and response processes.
* Monitor response quality, timeliness, and adherence to brand voice.
* Escalate sensitive or emerging issues to appropriate stakeholders and track resolution.

**Trends & Cultural Intelligence**

* Prepare and distribute regular trends emails, highlighting relevant cultural moments, platform developments, and social content trends.

* Pull, organize, and validate performance data for monthly metrics deep dives and ad-hoc reporting.

* Wellness reimbursement program

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - Marin
jobs.description:
*Review the full job description* *here**.*

**Youth Leadership Institute (yli)** brings together young people and their adult allies to create positive community change that promotes social justice and racial equity. With community-based programs based in Fresno, San Francisco, Marin, San Mateo, Merced, Long Beach and the Eastern Coachella Valley, yli engages young people of color, low-income youth, and other impacted youth as advocates of social change.

**yli CORE VALUES**

* **Inclusion**: Young people are profoundly impacted by policies affecting their communities. yli brings youth to the table and works to institutionalize youth voice in the decision-making process.
* **Innovation**: Youth can often see a way forward where adults cannot. yli encourages youth to identify and implement their own solutions to the issues their communities face.
* **Social Justice**: Throughout history, young people have ignited and led social justice movements to create a better world for everyone. yli helps them to focus their attention on the root causes of injustice, and sharpen the skills they need to tackle them.
* **Community**: Nobody can do it alone! Through relationship and coalition-building, yli feeds the connective tissue within our communities to power our movements with the brilliance, resourcefulness, and wisdom of our partners.

  

We are looking for a **Program Coordinator (PC)** in **Marin County.** The PC will work in partnership with youth (ages 12 – 24) to organize, empower and mobilize youth and their communities to win real improvements for Marin County young people.

The PC will train and support youth leaders to develop and deepen political consciousness, assess and understand issues impacting their health and well being, build relationships and partnerships with other youth and community supporters, and drive countywide and local community campaigns that create long- term systems and/or policy change, and build power for future victories.

This individual is responsible for managing all of the logistics and functional tasks necessary for meeting the goals and objectives of the assigned programs, and for ensuring that the young people are experiencing high-quality and culturally relevant leadership opportunities.

The PC will implement up to 3 school-based Friday Night Live programs (FNL). FNL is an evidence-based youth development framework to aid in the reduction of youth substance use, as well as implementing our Social Emotional Learning track through FNL. The PC will work directly in partnership with a variety of youth cohorts and adult allies to lead work that supports and leverages local efforts to amplify youth voices and create sustainable social justice change.

**If you’re a good fit for this position, we encourage you to apply. Send us your resume and cover letter on our** **website****.**

We are looking for candidates with:

* Commitment to yli’s values of community, inclusion, innovation, and social justice
* B.A. and/or a minimum 2-3 years relevant experience in field of youth development
* Commitment to social justice, public health, and community organizing as strategies to affect change
* Experience with social media and media relations
* Demonstrated capacity to work with youth and adults from communities of color and low-income communities
* Able to work some evenings and weekends
* Access to a personal vehicle and clean driving record, with the ability to transport youth

  

This position requires in-person work in the Marin County office or in the community 4 days per week, with the option to work remotely on the 5th day.

This is a full-time non-exempt position with a rate of $27.77/hr - $30.54/hr. Compensation includes yli’s generous benefits package:

* Fully-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (free options available for all staff, and yli pays 50% of dependent premiums)
* Paid time off (~50 days per year with Wellness Leave, Vacation/PTO, holidays, breaks, and your birthday holiday combined)
* $500/year for mental health or lifestyle spending accounts
* Health, commuter, and dependent care flexible spending accounts
* 403(b) retirement plan with 4% match after one year of service

  

**To apply, submit your cover letter and resume on our** **website****.**

**NO RECRUITERS**

***Inclusion sits at the center of yli’s programs.***  
*We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all members of our staff, clients, volunteers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients. People of color, LGBT persons, and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Youth Alumni who have participated and completed programs at yli are strongly encouraged to apply. yli is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against its employees or applicants based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, ancestry, age, medical condition, ability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, HIV/AIDS status and/or any other protected basis.*

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 50+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their career.

**Division Description**

Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

**Job Description**

Coordinates and monitors project activities including recruitment, in-service training, and other activities in cooperation with the project director and appropriate volunteer station staff. Facilitates placement of Foster Grandparent and Senior Companion volunteers in a variety of community-based child-centered and older adult-centered volunteer sites throughout San Francisco. Provides coordinated pre-service orientation, in-service instruction, and overall supervision of AmeriCorps Seniors volunteers with volunteer station professional staff. Coordinates volunteers’ assignments including assisting volunteer station staff to develop volunteer assignment plans and volunteer activities and monitoring progress toward achieving the expected outcomes and impact specified in assignment plans. Provides information and support to volunteers. Facilitates positive working relationships between volunteers and station staff.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Manages all aspects placement process for new FGP and SCP volunteers including, recruiting, arranging interviews, performing background checks and other vetting activities in alignment with AmeriCorps federal guidelines.
* Supports all outreach activities including but not limited to: community presentations, staff education and outreach to service providers, public housing clients, and other community members, to increase awareness and recruit new volunteers to the FGP/SCP Program.
* Utilizes social media and electronic communication to raise awareness of the FGP and SCP programs.
* Supports volunteers through verbal, written, and coordinated translation assistance.
* Develops and delivers all required volunteer training including pre- service orientations, in-service training, and annual re-certification of volunteers.
* Collaborates and supports the annual volunteer recognition event, ongoing recognition efforts, and other projects with FSA staff and outside agencies in conjunction with the FGP/SCP Program Staff.
* Helps facilitate the proper completion and timely submission of volunteer monthly timesheets. Coordinates with station supervisors and provides additional training to station staff. Coordinates the data entry of volunteer stipends into monthly spreadsheet, and submission to fiscal for processing.
* Provides administrative support to the program manager, and assists with data collection required for monthly, quarterly, and annual report processing.
* Collaborates with program staff and advisory council in the planning and implementation of the annual volunteer recognition event.
* Other duties as necessary.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

* A minimum of 2 or more years of experience in a supporting community-based program (experience working with the older adult population is a plus.)
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent educational experience.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **About Deploy**

Deploy is an intelligence infrastructure platform that gives developers and enterprises access to open source and proprietary AI models. For leading open source LLMs, Deploy operates an optimized model inference engine that keeps costs and latency low while maintaining high throughout. Deploy also offers a set of proprietary AI models that address challenges in content safety, AI & deepfake detection, sponsorship intelligence, and IP & publicity protection. Trusted by the world's largest and most innovative organizations, Deploy's solutions unlock high-performance AI model inference at production scale.

Deploy has raised more than $200M from leading investors, including Tomales Bay Capital, General Catalyst, 8VC, Glynn Capital, Bain & Company, Visa Ventures, and others. The company has more than 250 employees across offices in San Francisco, Seattle, New York, and Delhi.

### **Recruiting Coordinator**

Deploy is looking for a dedicated and enthusiastic individual to help as we continue to build our team of world-class talent. As a Recruiting Coordinator at Deploy, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact at one of the world’s leading AI product companies, engaging with both our internal team as well as potential future employees. Our ideal candidate for this position is self-motivated, highly organized, and flexible in a fast-paced environment. In this role, you will be expected to effectively convey our platforms, products, and ideas, so excellent communication skills are a must. You will work closely with our VP of Operations to develop new growth strategies, define weekly recruiting goals, and analyze the metrics of our hiring process. We need a team player who can express our vision and is eager to develop their recruiting skills at one of the most competitive companies in AI.

### **Responsibilities**

* Schedule a high volume of calls and onsite interviews while ensuring the internal team is fully informed
* Source and connect with potential candidates on various recruiting platforms
* Conduct phone-screens and assess a candidate’s fit for the role
* Manage candidate flow through our Applicant Tracking System, keeping all profiles up to date and accurate
* Set and crush weekly outreach goals
* Coordinate travel for non-local candidates
* Monitor and update job postings
* Guide candidates smoothly through their onsite interviews
* Maintain awareness of industry best practices for data maintenance handling as it relates to your role
* Adhere to policies, guidelines and procedures pertaining to the protection of information assets
* Report actual or suspected security and/or policy violations/breaches to an appropriate authority

### **Requirements**

* You have a BA / BS degree
* You possess excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, and are comfortable getting on the phone with anyone
* Your attention to detail is meticulous, even while juggling multiple tasks
* You take initiative and are able to prioritize your daily tasks without direct guidance
* You are skilled in Google Suite and proficient at typing

### **Who We Are**

We are a group of ambitious individuals who are passionate about creating a revolutionary AI company. At Deploy, you will have a steep learning curve and an opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest growing AI start-ups in San Francisco. The work you do here will have a noticeable and direct impact on the development of the company.

Thank you for your interest in Deploy and we hope to meet you soon!

The current expected base salary for this position ranges from $60,000 - $85,000. Actual compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the total compensation package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work; stock options may be offered in addition to the range provided here.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager - Consulting & Research Agencies
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re hiring a **Global Account Manager, Consulting & Research Agencies** to own and aggressively grow Outset’s relationships with the world’s leading **management consulting and professional services firms**.

A global consulting firm is not one customer; it’s hundreds. Strategy, customer and CX, digital and product, marketing, private equity and due diligence practices each run research for their clients—across dozens of countries, with partner-level budget owners and engagement-by-engagement buying. Firms also increasingly want to deliver AI-powered research as part of their own client offerings. That makes consulting both one of our biggest direct markets and a powerful route to the world’s largest enterprises.

This is a **senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales**. You’ll carry **full commercial ownership of a small number of global firms**—expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal—and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You’ll go deep in a handful of firms, build relationships from engagement managers to practice leaders to firm leadership, and turn project-by-project usage into firm-wide agreements.

You’ll do it with an account team around you—Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team—and in close partnership with our Partnerships team where firms bring Outset to their clients.

**Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of a small number of **global consulting and professional services firms**, with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Carry and exceed an **aggressive seven-figure growth target** across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each firm: every practice, industry group, region, and research function; partner-level relationships; whitespace and spend; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Convert **engagement-by-engagement usage into firm-wide and multi-year agreements**, including enterprise licenses, preferred-vendor status, and global MSAs.
* Multi-thread relentlessly—from consultants and engagement managers to partners, practice leaders, and firm leadership—building relationships durable enough to survive partner turnover and reorgs.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors) across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that tie Outset to firm outcomes—faster engagements, higher-margin delivery, and differentiated client offerings—and convert them into committed budget.
* Negotiate and close complex agreements—global MSAs, multi-region commitments, procurement, security, and client-data confidentiality reviews—in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of consulting firms back into Outset—informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion.
* Regularly meet in person with partner leads across practices to create deep relationships with those driving business performance and who are responsible for partner-level results delivery, as well as operational leaders in centralized roles.

**Qualifications**

* **10+ years in enterprise sales**, including **5+ years in a named global or strategic account role** owning a small book of major accounts.
* **Demonstrated experience and expertise selling into and growing accounts at global consulting, market research and professional services firms**—strategy firms, the Big Three, the largest global market research agencies or large digital and technology consultancies.
* Deep understanding of how consulting firms buy: **partner-led decisions, practice and regional budgets, engagement-funded spend**, and central procurement.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts*—expansion, cross-sell, and renewal—not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management, with accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with partners and firm leadership, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority.
* Experience with complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor—a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced startup that is still building the playbook.
* Travel regularly to customer sites will be necessary to achieve your goals, and should be part of your prior playbook. Travel to our San Francisco HQ will also be required periodically.
* Bonus: prior consulting experience, or experience selling research, insights,

--------------------

PolicyLift is the AI-native growth engine for independent P&C agencies: one platform that drives growth, consolidates fragments of point solutions, so agencies can source and close premium faster. Our team brings experiences from top-tier technology companies like Google, Meta, and Insurtech leaders like Qualia.

PolicyLift is VC-backed used by 1,000+ agents and actively services a book of over $1B in premium.

**About the Role**
------------------

You’re a former independent P&C agent who has quoted, bound, serviced and renewed policies. Now you'll draw on that experience to help build and implement technology that helps agents win more premium.

PolicyLift services a book of over $1B in premium, and we're adding agencies faster every month. This role is the person who helps get new agencies live, keeps their team unstuck, and brings the agent's point of view into what our team builds next. It's a hybrid of three things: product, onboarding, and ongoing agency success.

Customers listen to you because you've done their job. Our engineers listen to you for the same reason. You provide deep industry experience to solve real pain points at independent agencies.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

PolicyLift does four jobs for independent P&C agencies:

* **Grow.** Website, SEO, AI search and email marketing that bring in leads.
* **Intake.** AI agents, smart forms, and carrier data and documents, so every lead is captured and complete.
* **Submit.** One-click transfer to the systems that matter: AMS, CRM, raters and carriers.
* **Bind.** Comparisons and proposals that get the policy bound.

Every one of those touches the details agents care about: which carrier for which risk, what an HO-5 covers that an HO-3 doesn’t, how a BOP submission differs from a package. Agencies trust us with that work. The person who onboards them, trains their CSRs, and brings their feedback to our roadmap should speak their language fluently.

------------------

* Work directly with the leadership team on representing the independent agent, informing what we build, in what order, and what "done right" means for an agent.

* Participate in the industry by visiting agencies in person, attend conferences, and user groups as PolicyLift's most credible voice.

**Onboarding and Implementation**

**Support**

* Be the first call when an agency hits something insurance-specific: a quote that doesn't look right, a carrier question, a workflow the AI should handle differently.
* Reproduce, document and triage issues before escalating to engineering, then follow them through to resolution.
* Help drive adoption early (low usage, reverted workflows, a CSR who went back to the old way) and fix the root cause: retraining, a workflow change, or a product request.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A former (or current) agent.** You hold or recently held a P&C license, and you've spent 3+ years in an independent agency as a producer, or account manager
* **Fluent in personal and commercial lines.** You can explain HO-3 vs. HO-5, when an umbrella makes sense, BOP vs. package, GL class codes, experience mods and commercial auto symbols without looking them up.
* **Hands-on with agency tech.** You've lived inside an AMS, run comparative raters, worked carrier portals and download feeds.
* **A process builder.** You see the whole process from lead to renewal, not just the next task, and you notice where it breaks before you get there.
* **Bilingual: insurance agent and product specialist.** You can earn an agency owner's trust in the morning and walk an engineer through an edge case in the afternoon.
* **Curious about AI.** You don't need to write code. You do need to want to understand how the product works and help it get better.

**Bonus qualifications**

* You've led an AMS or rater migration or implementation.
* You've tried AI tools in your agency and know where they fall short.
* Any product or tech-adjacent experience.

We're looking for someone who wants to be on both sides of the customer relationship. You'll start the conversations that become deals, then make sure those customers get real value once they sign.

As a Sales Development Representative at Endex, you'll own pipeline generation, qualification, onboarding and adoption. You'll work directly with our founders, AEs and product team to shape who we sell to, how customers succeed and what we build next.

* **Performance:** Research target accounts, map buying teams and run outbound across email, LinkedIn and phone. Book qualified meetings for our AEs and founders.
* **Onboard New Customers:** Get new teams live fast. Run kickoff sessions, set up integrations and make sure every user sees value in their first week.
* **Drive Adoption:** Work with customers to find new use cases across email, Teams, Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Turn a single team's pilot into firmwide usage.

* **Protect and Expand Accounts:** Monitor usage, spot risk early and surface expansion opportunities. Partner with AEs on renewals and upsells.

* **Driven:** 2+ years in sales, customer success, consulting, banking or another fast-paced client-facing role. You have a track record of excellence and set a high bar for yourself.

* **Technically curious:** You want to understand how agentic systems work, not just how to talk about them. You learn a new tool quickly and can teach it to others.
* **Credible with experts:** You can hold your own with analysts, operators and executives. You learn a domain fast and speak its language.

* Competitive Salary + Equity

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Why Mintlify?**
=================

We're on a mission to empower builders.

* **Massive reach:** Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.
* **Small team, huge impact:** We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.
* **Culture of** **slope over y-intercept****:** We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

**What you'll work on here**
============================

You'll own targeted outbound into Enterprise and Strategic accounts. You'll research each account, find the right Director+ technical buyers, and reach them by email, phone, and LinkedIn. Your goal is booking meetings that our AEs turn into qualified opportunities.

* **Research:** Dig into an account before you reach out: their docs, their developer platform, how well AI agents can read their docs today, and who owns them.
* **Outreach:** Write messages that speak credibly to Director+ technical buyers. Personalize every touch to the account and the person.
* **Calling:** Calls are part of the mix, alongside email and LinkedIn. You're calling people you've researched, not dialing down a list all day.
* **Events:** Invite the right prospects to AE-hosted dinners and events, and make sure they show up.

**What you bring to the table**
===============================

* Incredibly fast learner - either with experience prospecting into engineering teams, or an ability to learn quickly
* Curiosity and the drive to show up, ask questions, work hard, and ride the highs and the lows. Absolutely non-negotiable
* Willingness to leverage AI powered technology to create efficiencies in your day to day cadence
* Ability to communicate credibly with technical buyers. You can hold a conversation with a Director or VP of Engineering about developer experience, documentation workflows, API strategy, and how AI agents read docs, without sounding like you're reading a script
* Strong written communication. Outreach reads like it was written by a thoughtful person, not a sequence tool. You personalize every touch for critical personas and accounts
* Research depth. You can look at an account and quickly understand why they're a fit, who the right contacts are, and what pain to lead with.
* Organizational discipline. CRM hygiene, clean handoff notes, systematic follow-up. You don't let things fall through the cracks.
* Appropriate Persistence. You know the difference between following up and spamming.
* Salesforce proficiency, outbound tooling including Nooks, Lemlist, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and others.

**Bonus Points****:**
=====================

* Prior SDR/BDR experience in B2B SaaS - particularly having sold to technical buyers or developer-focused companies
* Experience with event-based or dinner-based sales motions
* Background at a PLG or developer-tools company (you understand how product-led and sales-led motions coexist)

**Why you should join our sales team**
======================================

You'll be joining a company where the product sells itself to developers. Your job is instrumental in helping us bring Mintlify to the enterprise buyers who can deploy it at scale. The product-market fit is real. What we're building now is the sales motion to match.  
This is a ground-floor opportunity to build something. You won't be plugging into a mature SDR org with a playbook someone else wrote. You'll be writing the playbook and we'll be here to help you nail it.  
  
**Your path to AE**  
We hire SDRs to grow into AEs. You'll learn how enterprise deals get built from the first touch, and as you prove yourself, you'll move toward running deals of your own.

**Company Benefits:**
=====================

* Competitive compensation and equity
* 20 days paid time off every year
* 401k with Employer Match
* monthly wellness stipend
* 100% employee coverage for Health, Dental, Vision
* Commute stipend to help get you to and from work
* Free lunch and dinners
* Annual team offsite (previously went to Alaska, Hawaii, Jackson Hole)

Compensation Range: $80K - $115K

Located in Staten Island, New York, we specialize in elder law, estate planning, business law, real estate, and more.

The **Client Services Coordinator** is a cornerstone role within our firm, vital to upholding our commitment to exceptional client experience. As the welcoming face and reassuring voice for prospective and current clients, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring smooth interactions and fostering trust. This role is crucial for maintaining our firm's reputation and supports our mission by ensuring each client interaction feels personal and impactful.

**What you’ll do:**

* **Client Communication & Front Desk Operations:** Serve as the first point of contact by managing a high volume of inbound calls, greeting clients and visitors, providing exceptional client service, gathering information accurately, and ensuring inquiries are efficiently routed to the appropriate team members.

Administrative Coordinator - LaGuardia CARES

**POSITION DETAILS**

Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one-third of LaGuardia’s degree-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first-generation college students.

Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25. Forty-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. jobs.title: Global Account Manager - Consulting & Research Agencies
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re hiring a **Global Account Manager, Consulting & Research Agencies** to own and aggressively grow Outset’s relationships with the world’s leading **management consulting and professional services firms**.

A global consulting firm is not one customer; it’s hundreds. Strategy, customer and CX, digital and product, marketing, private equity and due diligence practices each run research for their clients—across dozens of countries, with partner-level budget owners and engagement-by-engagement buying. Firms also increasingly want to deliver AI-powered research as part of their own client offerings. * Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.

**Qualifications**

**Company Description**

Wix makes it possible for anyone to succeed online. Since 2006, we've grown to around 4,400 employees in 22 countries, launched over 40 products, and serve over 299 million users and their visitors worldwide. At Wix, we push you to innovate and evolve in non-traditional ways. We operate in collaborative, high-performing teams, building cutting-edge products and leveraging AI to redefine how our users create, manage and grow their dreams online.

Although we're already industry leaders in web creation and business, our work is nowhere near done. Our goal is to become the main engine of the Internet so we can create a more open web for all.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Wix was built around the idea that everyone has the right to be successful, online. This same vision defines us as an employer: creating a work environment where everyone is welcome, and anyone has the right to succeed.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a sharp, trend-obsessed Social Media Manager to manage the social presence of some of Wix's biggest brands, including Wix.com, Wix Studio and Symphony. You will own the strategy and the craft: planning what we say and where, then creating the short-form videos that bring it to life, for both organic and paid, from A to Z.

This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who lives on social, spots trends before they peak, and can take an idea from a first hook to a published video on their own.  
  
On your day to day you will:

* Establish social media strategies for various Wix products across short form video platforms - TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts.
* Build and manage content calendars, balancing always-on organic content with campaign, launch and product moments
* Create short-form video content from A to Z: concepting, scripting, shooting, editing, captioning and publishing, for both organic and paid use
* Develop platform-native content that fits the nuances of each channel and each brand's voice and audience
* Partner with the paid media team to produce, test and iterate on social ad creative, including hooks, formats and variations
* Monitor trends, memes, sounds and formats, and turn them into timely content that feels native and fresh
* Track performance across channels, report on results and use insights to optimize content, formats and posting strategy
* Use AI and automation tools to speed up ideation, production and editing, and experiment with new workflows

At Wix, we believe our best work happens together. Our work model is fully in person, with 3 days a week from our New York office.

 **Qualifications**

* 1-2 years of experience in social media, content creation or a similar role (agency, in-house at a tech/AI brand or personal brand experience all count)
* Proven ability to create short-form video end to end, with a portfolio or sample videos that show your work
* Hands-on editing skills with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar
* Hands-on experience with Ai video creation tools, like Higgsfield, Weavy or similar
* A fresh perspective on social and an intuitive grasp of trends, formats, creators and culture across TikTok, Instagram and beyond
* Natural instinct for strong hooks, storytelling and what makes people stop scrolling
* Understanding of content strategy and planning, including calendars, platform best practices and audience insights
* Familiarity with paid social creative and what makes an ad perform, or strong curiosity to learn fast
* Strong writing skills and a clear, clever tone of voice
* Analytical mindset: comfortable reading metrics and adapting based on performance
* Self-starter who ships consistently, takes initiative and thrives in a fast-moving environment
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent English (written and spoken)

 **Additional Information**

Expected base compensation salary range $110,000 - $130,000. In addition to base pay you will receive company RSUs as part of the compensation package.Final package may vary and will be determined by various factors including location the role is expected to be performed, shift, candidate profile and ideal qualifications.

**Manufacturer’s Sales Representative / Outside Sales Representative**  
**New York Territory & New Business Development**

**This is an established-territory sales position with a strong new-business development component.**

Stonehenge US is looking for a motivated Outside Sales Representative to manage and grow our established dealer network throughout Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island and surrounding New York markets, while also developing new business and expanding our presence throughout the region.

This is a hybrid sales position combining **account management, territory growth, and new-business development**. The representative will be responsible for maintaining strong relationships with existing dealers, identifying opportunities to grow current accounts, prospecting new dealer locations, and helping expand Stonehenge US into untapped areas of the New York market.

Depending on the candidate’s experience and qualifications, the position may be structured as a dedicated outside-sales role or may include product and sample delivery responsibilities within the territory.

Our products include natural stone veneer, manufactured stone, thin brick, bluestone, limestone and step treads, porcelain pavers, artificial grass, outdoor living products, solar paver lights, iron doors, and other building and hardscape products.

**Compensation & Schedule**

* $70,000 base salary or more if include product and sample delivery responsibilities within the territory.

* Monday through Friday
* Approximately 45 hours per week
* Full-time position

* Company Ford F-150 or other company-provided vehicle depending on the position structure

Stonehenge US’s main warehouse and office is located in Staten Island, New York. This position will spend the majority of its time in the field managing and developing accounts throughout Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island, Staten Island, and surrounding New York markets.

Because of the territory, candidates located in or near Staten Island, Brooklyn, Queens, Long Island, or surrounding areas would be well positioned for this role.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

We are looking for someone who is comfortable both managing an established territory and developing new business.

Stonehenge US is a growing supplier and manufacturer of masonry, hardscape, and outdoor-living products serving building-material dealers throughout the Northeast.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Hyphenate**

Most AI companies in finance are building copilots. Hyphenate builds AI agents that do the work.

Hyphenate is the autonomous finance platform for the office of the CFO. Our agents run on top of a company's existing ERP, banks, billing, CRM and contracts, and take on the work itself: order-to-cash and revenue recognition, cash and treasury, procure-to-pay, general ledger and close, and reporting. They learn how each company runs finance, log every action for auditors, and escalate the decisions that need human judgment. No ERP migration, no rip-and-replace.

We are based in New York City and backed by a $9M seed round led by Foundation Capital, with BoldCap, Gaia Ventures, Aravind Srinivas (CEO of Perplexity) and finance leaders from Zuora, Ramp, Gusto, MongoDB, Zoom and the Big Four. Customers include Kiteworks, HiBid, Dura Software, Mini Melts and Rently.

**About the Role**

We are hiring Business Development Representatives to build the outbound engine for the office of the CFO.

The demand is already here. CFOs and Controllers at $100M to $1B companies are being asked by their CEOs how AI will change their teams, and we have the product that answers it. What we need is more conversations. Our BDRs are the people who start them: on the phone, every day, with the finance leaders who run the close, the cash and the revenue at companies in our target verticals.

This is a founding cohort. We are three Account Executives and three BDRs today and plan to be ten of each by the end of January. You will own a vertical, not a list: one segment of the market that you learn cold, prospect end to end, and build the playbook for. You report to our Head of Sales Development, who built the SDR organization at Rippling from three people to thirty, and you will get direct coaching from the CRO and the AEs you book for.

The BDR team is our farm system for Account Executives. We promote from within on discipline, coachability and execution, and we are adding AE seats fast enough that the path is real.

**What You'll Own**

* Own a vertical: run outbound into one segment of $100M to $1B companies (B2B software, CPG, manufacturing, wholesale distribution, construction, hospitality or health services) and become the person on the team who knows it best
* Live on the phone: roughly four hours a day of cold calls to CFOs, Controllers and VPs of Finance, with email and LinkedIn layered in as we stand those channels up
* Book and hold 12 to 15 qualified meetings a month at full ramp, and hand each one to your AE with a real brief: who they are, what hurts, what systems they run, and what happens next
* Work inbound in your segment: content downloads and demo requests route to you, and you follow up the same day
* Research before you dial: ERP, close process, PE backing, hiring signals, so the first thirty seconds of every call land
* Partner with your AE on account plans, multi-threading into the finance org, and reviving closed-lost accounts
* Keep HubSpot clean: every call, meeting and note logged, so the funnel we run the business on is real
* Write and test talk tracks and sequences with the Head of Sales Development; what works becomes the playbook for the next ten BDRs
* Bring the market back inside: the objections you hear, the messaging that lands, and the segments that bite

**What You Should Have Done Before**

* Earned attention from strangers for a living. Either 6 to 24 months as an outbound BDR or SDR with a quota you hit, or a non-traditional background with hard evidence you can do measurable work under pressure: college athletics, a founder stint, client-facing finance or consulting
* Picked up the phone when it was the harder option. Cold calling is the core of this job today, and you should want it to be
* Held a conversation with a finance leader, or shown you can learn enough accounting to hold one within your first month
* Taken coaching well. You want your calls reviewed, and you change what you do when you get the feedback
* Executed a process every day without being chased: the activity, the logging, the follow-up
* Based in New York City or willing to relocate; we work from our Manhattan office five days a week
* High energy, high agency. You bring it to the floor and the people dialing next to you feel it

**You'll Stand Out If**

* You have prospected into finance buyers (CFO, Controller, treasury, RevOps) at a fintech, ERP, billing, close or spend-management company
* You have an accounting, audit or FP&A background, or a CPA you would rather use in a conversation than a spreadsheet
* You were a founding or early BDR somewhere and helped write the playbook, not just run it
* You build your own tooling: AI prospecting workflows, enrichment, call prep, anything that gets you to more of the right conversations
* You competed at a high level in something: Division I sports, a startup you founded, a job with a public scoreboard

**What Great Looks Like Here**

* You treat the phone as the best channel, not the last resort. A live conversation is the strongest pattern interrupt there is, and you go get it
* You want the AE seat, and you are earning it by doing the job in front of you better than anyone else
* You are curious about how a finance team actually closes the books, and you can explain what our agents do for one in two sentences
* You dial with the people next to you, share what is working, and make the floor louder

**The Upside**

* $90K base salary plus $50K in annual on-target commission, for a $140K OTE, and equity
* A real ramp: your first month of commission is guaranteed, month two runs on an adjusted quota, and you are at full ramp by month three
* A real path: the BDR team is where our next Account Executives come from, and we are adding AE seats as fast as we add BDRs
* Coaching every week from a Head of Sales Development who has scaled this exact function, plus call feedback from the CRO and the AEs you book for
* Medical, dental and vision co
