jobs.description:
**Join the Glowbar Team:**

Glowbar is reinventing the facial with custom, 30-minute treatments led by expert estheticians, designed to deliver results. Since launching in NYC in 2019, we’ve grown fast, with locations across the Northeast and more on the way.

The People Operations Coordinator keeps the engine of our Talent and Culture team running. You’re the person studio teams count on to get it right - every question answered, every system change made, every referral bonus paid accurately and on time. When the details are handled, our studio teams can stay focused on helping clients feel confident in their skin. If you love being the organized, reliable, detail-obsessed partner behind a great team member experience, this is your role.

**What You’ll Do:**

You’ll be the operational backbone of the Talent and Culture team, partnering with team members across our studios. Every day, you’ll:

* Own the inbox as the first point of contact for our studio teams - triaging questions on pay, policies, systems, and paperwork, resolving what you can quickly, and routing the rest to the right partner
* Keep our HRIS accurate by processing team member changes in ADP, including new hires, promotions, transfers, pay rate updates, status changes, and terminations, and managing user access in our systems as team members join and leave
* Support onboarding and offboarding administration in partnership with Talent Acquisition including new hire paperwork, I-9 and compliance documents, system setup, exit documentation, and fi nal pay coordination
* Support leave administration in partnership with the HRBP, including tracking leaves of absence, processing leave paperwork and status changes in ADP, and coordinating with carriers and state leave programs
* Administer benefits day to day, including new hire enrollment and eligibility, qualifying life events, COBRA notices, and coordination with our benefits brokers/carriers
* Handle routine employment requests such as employment and income verifi cations, unemployment claim responses, and wage garnishments, accurately and on time
* Track bonuses from referrals through eligibility to payout, so every team member who brings great people to Glowbar gets paid correctly and on time
* Support state payroll tax and unemployment registrations as Glowbar expands into new markets
* Maintain organized, audit-ready team member fi les, keep labor law postings current in every studio, and track handbook and policy acknowledgments
* Pull reports and data to support the Talent and Culture team as well as other cross-functional departments
* Turn repeat questions into resources by building and updating SOPs, templates, and FAQs that help studio teams self-serve

**Who We’re Looking For:**

* 1–3 years of experience in HR, People Operations, payroll, or administrative support
* Hands-on HRIS experience (ADP preferred); experience with multi-state payroll and benefits administration is a strong plus
* A detail-obsessed approach - you double-check the numbers because you know it matters to people
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to keep a busy inbox moving and prioritize what’s urgent
* Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information
* Clear, warm communication skills, especially in writing
* Enthusiasm for beauty, skincare, and a fast-paced, service-driven environment

**Your Glow Package (Compensation & Benefits):**

* Annual compensation increase eligibility
* Annual bonus potential tied to company EBITDA performance
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance largely covered by Glowbar
* Unlimited paid time off and sick leave
* 6 paid holidays
* DailyPay — access part of your paycheck before payday at no cost
* Disability, accident, critical illness, and life insurance coverage
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental wellness support
* Commuter benefits to help save on transit and parking
* Free annual Glowbar membership ($900 value) and two annual guest passes ($190 value)
* 30% employee discount off skincare products
* $150 employee referral bonuses for bringing great people to the team
* $15 product credit for every first-time client you refer

**Working Conditions:**

This is a fast-paced, primarily desk-based role. You should be comfortable with:

* Extended periods of computer work and managing a high volume of email and system tasks
* Occasional local travel to studios for team support and onboarding
* Handling confidential information with care and discretion

This is not just a receptionist or scheduling role. This person will be the primary point of contact for clients and real estate agents, manage inspection scheduling and office workflows, coordinate with inspectors and virtual assistants, and help keep the operations side of the company running smoothly.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through, notices the small details, solves problems, and wants the opportunity to grow into a leadership role as the company expands.

* Inspection schedules are accurate and efficient.
* Work orders are complete and properly documented.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

* Operations coordination

Working under an independent contractor structure (1099-NEC) with a competitive base of **$40k – $50k annually** plus an uncapped performance commission model with an **OTE of $138k – $172k+ annually**, you will leverage your market knowledge and B2B network to source, negotiate, and close high-value real estate opportunities.

**Duties**

* **Business Development & Sourcing:** Identify, prospect, and secure land assignment deals, lot acquisitions, and third-party construction projects across Metro Atlanta.

* **Construction & Inventory Sales:** Present third-party construction services (self-sourced and company-provided inbound leads) and represent single-family inventory sales.
* **Pipeline & CRM Management:** Maintain clean records, register every opportunity in the company CRM before discussions begin, and track deals from origination to payout.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:** 3+ years of proven business development, B2B sales, or land acquisition experience in residential real estate, construction, or real estate investment.
* **Local Network:** An established network of real estate investors, builders, developers, brokers, or lenders in Metro Atlanta.
* **Track Record:** Demonstrated ability to independently manage a pipeline, negotiate contracts, and consistently close real estate transactions
* **Self-Directed:** Discipline to operate autonomously without day-to-day supervision while maintaining clear deal records in CRM.
* **Skills:** Strong negotiation, relationship-building, presentation, and CRM skills.
* An active Georgia Real Estate License is a plus, but not required. Must be authorized to work in the US under a 1099 framework.

Pay: $138,000.00 - $172,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Backed by a team of elite service technicians, you will identify operational bottlenecks, pitch high-performance dock and door solutions, and build a book of business with **uncapped commission potential**. Fluid Flow is a trusted provider of compressed air solutions, helping industrial customers improve productivity, efficiency, and system reliability. We specialize in air compressors, dryers, filtration, blowers, and related compressed air equipment, backed by experienced technical support and comprehensive service capabilities. From equipment selection and system design to installation, maintenance, and repair, Fluid Flow delivers dependable solutions that help customers maximize uptime and performance.

Visit our website: fluidflow.com

Job Description:

**Summary**

The Outside Sales Representative is responsible for driving profitable growth within an assigned territory by selling compressed air equipment, air treatment products, nitrogen generation systems, and service agreements. This role requires strong technical aptitude, a consultative selling approach, and the ability to partner with customers across industrial environments. The representative will identify opportunities, develop engineered solutions, and ensure long-term customer satisfaction while meeting or exceeding sales targets.

**Responsibilities**

**Sales & Revenue Growth**

* Identify, pursue, and secure new customers for compressors, dryers, filtration, nitrogen generators, and turnkey system solutions.
* Grow existing accounts through strategic account planning and cross-selling of equipment and service offerings.
* Consistently achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals.
* Develop detailed territory and funnel plans to grow market share across key industrial segments.

* Support customers through the full sales cycle—from opportunity identification to commissioning coordination.

**Technical & Product Knowledge**

* Maintain strong working knowledge of compressed air systems, including rotary screw, piston, and oil-free compressors, dryers, filtration, condensate management, and nitrogen generation.
* Understand service offerings such as planned maintenance, warranty extensions, audits, leak detection, and equipment upgrades.
* Stay current on industry innovations, competitive product lines, and energy efficiency technologies.

**Territory & Pipeline Management**

* Develop and execute a structured weekly plan for customer visits, prospecting, and follow-ups.
* Maintain accurate opportunity data, quoting status, and forecasting in CRM.
* Conduct on-site evaluations, energy assessments (when applicable), and coordinate air audits with internal technical teams.
* Attend industry events, trade shows, and customer trainings to expand pipeline and market presence.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with service teams to ensure excellent post-sale support and promote maintenance agreements.
* Partner with inside sales, engineering, and operations to deliver accurate quotes, equipment sizing, and project execution.
* Engage with marketing to support lead generation efforts and targeted campaigns.

**Qualifications**

* 2–5+ years of outside sales experience in industrial equipment, compressed air systems, HVAC, mechanical systems, or similar technical fields.
* Strong mechanical aptitude with the ability to learn complex systems.
* Proven record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to interpret technical data such as CFM requirements, PSI, dew point, and energy usage.
* Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel frequently within the territory.

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.  
  
TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.  
  
**Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at TriNet you will serve as the face of a well established, reputable company that empowers the small business community to focus on what matters most – growing their business. This individual is often the first line of communication between TriNet and prospective clients as the person responsible for identifying, contacting and qualifying opportunities for the sales organization to generate new business. This role, coupled with TriNet emphasis on continuous learning and defined career paths, will lay the foundation for a successful sales career. If you are somebody looking to accelerate your sales development career with a high growth, stable company and rewarding mission, then come join us!  
  
**What you will do**

* Secure meetings with the right people, at the right place, at the right time to create high quality sales opportunities for the field sales team.
* The focus each day for our SDRs is getting connected with decision makers, extending the conversation, and securing meetings for our field sales team.
* Use internal sales tools and resources to execute a high touch sales cadence on prospects.
* Make around 80 cold calls a day to prospects to gauge interest.
* Initiate contact with prospects through a multi-channel outbound prospecting strategy using phone calls, email, and LinkedIn.
* Attend meetings you’ve scheduled and conduct routine check-ins with your Sales Consultant to receive feedback on the opportunities you have created.
* Execute a follow-up strategy on prospects that were not interested but maybe in the future or were interested but did not buy.
* Develop new sales strategies based on personal successes and failures and share what’s working with your peers!
* Performs other duties as assigned
* Complies with all policies and standards

**Education Qualifications**

* High School Diploma required or
* Bachelor's Degree preferred

**Experience Qualifications**

* Typically < 1 year Sales prospecting and research preferred

**Skills and Abilities**

* Articulate and persuasive written and oral communicator (Intermediate proficiency)
* Demonstrate willingness to grow through discomfort – fearless! (Intermediate proficiency)
* Seeks out, internalizes, and applies coaching feedback (Intermediate proficiency)
* Strong work ethic and self-drive (Intermediate proficiency)
* A believer in the fruits of a disciplined process (Intermediate proficiency)
* Strong attention to detail and highly organized (Intermediate proficiency)
* Great active-listening skills (Intermediate proficiency)
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude in the face of rejection and failure (Intermediate proficiency)
* Enjoys collaborating with internal and cross-functional teams (Intermediate proficiency)
* Strong computer literacy skills (Intermediate proficiency)
* Experience using a CRM; Salesforce preferred (Intermediate proficiency)
* A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace (Intermediate proficiency)

**Travel Requirements**  
Minimal  
  
**Work Environment**

* Work in clean, pleasant, and comfortable office or home setting. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable persons with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The preferred location for this role is Atlanta, GA, and the salary range for this location is $20.00 to $23.08. All qualified external applicants will be considered for an in-office role, based in Atlanta. All qualified internal candidates are encouraged to apply and consider relocation to Atlanta and may be considered for remote hire at the company’s discretion. The candidate’s final salary offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, education, work location and experience.

Candidates hired into roles in the sales organization are also eligible for commissions consistent with TriNet’s commission plan.

Additionally, subject to applicable eligibility requirements, TriNet offers permanent full-time employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, life and disability insurance, a 401(K) savings plan, an employee stock purchase plan, eleven (11) Company observed holidays, PTO and a comprehensive leave program. Please click the following link for detailed information about our benefits offerings: https://www.trinet.com/documents/blt5b61a1040aae1904

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
====================

The Operations Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and managing the flow of materials, equipment, vendor commitments, logistics, field scheduling, and service activity required to support Solar Energy Partners Operations. The role is the primary Operations owner for material readiness, procurement visibility, and the field schedule for all field work, including installations, site surveys, and service visits, and is accountable for ensuring that service work is properly received, documented, coordinated, tracked, and moved through completion.

**Core Accountabilities**
=========================

**Procurement & Cost Control**
------------------------------

* Coordinate purchasing of approved project materials, equipment, rentals, and other assigned operational requirements.
* Obtain, compare, and document vendor pricing, availability, lead times, and delivery commitments.
* Create and maintain clear visibility of purchase status, backorders, substitutions, and expected delivery dates.
* Support project cost control by maintaining accurate purchasing information and identifying material or vendor cost risks early.
* Escalate material substitutions, design conflicts, or specification questions for technical approval before purchase.

**Material Readiness & Logistics**
----------------------------------

* Maintain forward visibility of material requirements for the active installation schedule and identify jobs at risk because of material, equipment, or vendor constraints.
* Coordinate receiving, inventory location, staging, job pulls, transfers, deliveries, and other assigned logistics activities.
* Coordinate equipment rentals and related delivery/pickup requirements as assigned.
* Work with Field Operations and Project Management to confirm that required materials are available before scheduled work begins.

**Field Scheduling**
--------------------

* Own the schedule for all field work, including installations, site surveys, service visits, and other assigned field activities.
* Schedule work only after prerequisites are confirmed, including material readiness, permit/interconnection milestones, customer availability, and crew and equipment availability.
* Coordinate with Field Operations on crew availability, capacity, job duration estimates, and sequencing to build a realistic, conflict-free schedule.
* Confirm appointments with customers and communicate schedule changes promptly to customers, field crews, Project Management, and other affected stakeholders.
* Manage reschedules, cancellations, weather delays, and scheduling conflicts, and keep the schedule current in Coperniq.
* Maintain forward visibility of the upcoming field schedule and crew capacity, and flag gaps, overbooking, or jobs at risk of slipping.

**Service Coordination**
------------------------

* Receive and organize service requests in accordance with the approved Operations workflow.
* Ensure service opportunities, work orders, notes, supporting documentation, and status information are entered and maintained in Coperniq.
* Coordinate service needs with Field Operations and schedule field service visits in accordance with the approved workflow.
* Track open service items from intake through field completion, documentation, closeout, and readiness for invoicing.
* Escalate service items that are aging, blocked, customer-sensitive, or likely to affect cost or schedule.

**Systems, Documentation & Reporting**
======================================

* Maintain complete and timely procurement, logistics, service, and vendor notes in Coperniq and other approved company systems.
* Document significant vendor communications, delivery commitments, shortages, backorders, schedule changes, service updates, and resolution status in the applicable job or opportunity file.
* Maintain weekly visibility of open purchase orders, material readiness, backorders, the upcoming field schedule, upcoming installation risks, service backlog, and completed service activity.
* Participate in Operations scorecard, KPI, L10, and other reporting processes as assigned by the Office Operations Manager.
* Support actual-cost and project-profitability reporting by providing accurate purchasing, rental, and material information when requested.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**
=================================

* Coordinate with Field Operations on field scheduling, crew capacity, installation readiness, site needs, service execution, deliveries, and material-related field issues.
* Coordinate with Project Managers on project timing, installation and site survey scheduling, permit/interconnection milestones, customer commitments, and material requirements.
* Work with HR, Accounting, and other administrative functions as needed to support approved Operations processes and documentation.

**Performance Expectations**
============================

* Material readiness for scheduled work and early identification of procurement or logistics risks.
* An accurate, current field schedule with prerequisites confirmed before work is dispatched, and timely communication of schedule changes.
* Timely and accurate purchase, vendor, delivery, and inventory status information.
* Consistent management of service intake, backlog, aging, documentation, and completion status.
* Accurate and timely use of Coperniq, including required notes and task/status updates.
* Responsiveness, ownership, communication, and follow-through across Operations handoffs.
* Achievement of assigned weekly scorecard measures and quarterly KPI targets.

**Qualifications / Capabilities**
=================================

* Strong organization, prioritization, follow-up, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors, projects, deadlines, and competing operational priorities.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Stratix Corporation is the trusted advisor for many industry-leading global enterprises, offering the most comprehensive managed services portfolio to help companies operationalize and realize the full value of their mobile investments. Our passion is partnering with businesses to operationalize their mobile investments with high-value services that drive competitive differentiation.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Logistics Coordinator manages domestic and international shipping operations to ensure timely, compliant, and cost-effective movement of goods. This role coordinates transportation, documentation, customs requirements, and shipment tracking while maintaining accurate records and resolving logistical issues.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with hazardous materials (HAZMAT) shipping, including applicable regulatory and documentation requirements, as well as international freight and customs processes. Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills are essential for coordinating with carriers, suppliers, customers, and internal teams.

**Responsibilities Include:**
-----------------------------

* Pick, pack, and prepare customer orders for shipment in accordance with invoices, work orders, or pick lists.
* Ensure all outgoing shipments are securely packaged, properly labeled, and meet company and carrier requirements.
* Print, apply, and verify shipping labels, barcodes, packing slips, and related documentation.
* Coordinate with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL, freight companies, etc.) to schedule pickups, track deliveries, and resolve shipping issues.
* Perform quality checks on outgoing shipments to confirm accuracy of items, quantities, and condition.
* Update inventory systems to reflect shipped items and maintain accurate shipping records.
* Operate warehouse equipment (pallet jacks, forklifts) safely and in compliance with company policies.
* Follow warehouse safety procedures and comply with shipping regulations, including hazardous materials handling (if applicable).
* Assist with receiving inbound shipments, cycle counts, and inventory audits as needed.
* Support warehouse team members and contribute to process improvement initiatives to enhance shipping efficiency.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications****:**
-----------------------

* 3-5 years of experience.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Previous warehouse or shipping/receiving experience preferred.
* Basic computer skills and familiarity with inventory management or shipping software.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and stand/walk for extended periods.
* Effective communication and teamwork skills.
* Forklift certification (or willingness to obtain) preferred.

**Work Environment:**
---------------------

* Warehouse setting with exposure to varying temperatures.
* Fast-paced, team-oriented environment with deadlines to meet.
* Requires use of some safety equipment.

**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

This role supports and assists the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close-out and financial reports, processing invoices for payment, collecting rent, fees, and other payments, completing bank deposits, dispositions, and account reconciliations, and using the property management software to record, track, and report on all financial workings of the community.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Property Type: Garden**

**Stage: Stabilized**

**Unit Count: 288**

**Schedule: Monday-Friday + rotating weekends Job Requirements:**

The Marketing Coordinator is a creative, design-focused member of the marketing team responsible for bringing our brand, events, and neighborhood initiatives to life across social, digital, email, and print channels.

Graphic design is at the heart of this role. The Marketing Coordinator will lead the day-to-day execution of creative materials for our core events, programs, and campaigns while helping establish a consistent and compelling visual identity across the organization.

In addition to design, this position will support social media content creation and management, website and email marketing, and other special marketing projects. The ideal candidate is a strong visual storyteller who can move comfortably between creative execution and collaborative project work.

* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager - CVS Media Exchange (CMX)
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

CVS Media Exchange [CMX] is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for our suppliers, merchants, stores, GMs, brand advertisers, and agencies. Our full-funnel ad solutions leverage CVS’s in-store and online data, extensive reach, and to provide measurable results for our clientele. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service; these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, engage with CVS consumers, and convert CVS consumers to shoppers.

The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for leading strategic coordination and performance oversight across digital media campaigns, ensuring seamless collaboration between internal teams and external suppliers. This individual manages the end-to-end campaign lifecycle—from kick-off through execution and wrap-up—driving precision in launch, optimization mid-flight, and delivery of actionable insights. The ideal candidate is a proactive partner with deep expertise in media strategy and supplier engagement, capable of identifying upsell opportunities and nurturing relationships to expand partnerships and generate incremental revenue for the business.

**Responsibilities include but not limited to:**

* Strategic Planning & Campaign Development
  + Develop annual brand and media strategies aligned with advertiser goals and growth objectives.
  + Create campaign strategies and audience targeting recommendations tailored to brand and product lines.
  + Build strategic supplier growth proposals based on a deep understanding of supplier business goals and marketing objectives.

  

* Client & Supplier Engagement
  + Serve as the primary liaison for supplier communications, including feedback, approvals, and creative revisions.
  + Maintain strong relationships with clients, managing day-to-day business and identifying opportunities to drive incremental revenue.
  + Educate advertisers on performance metrics, insights, and optimization strategies to improve results.

  

* Campaign Execution & Optimization
  + Lead campaign kick-offs, manage briefs, and confirm media planning details.
  + Oversee campaign performance in collaboration with internal teams.
  + Monitor campaign performance using KPIs and data-driven insights to optimize outcomes.

  

* Reporting & Performance Analysis
  + Perform in-depth data analysis to deliver actionable insights and recommendations for short- and long-term media strategies.
  + Collaborate with Insights and Strategy team to ensure reporting accuracy.
  + Deliver campaign performance reports, conduct wrap-up calls, and finalize Campaign Performance Reviews (CPRs)

  

* Cross-Functional Collaboration
  + Work closely with sales, merchandising, and internal teams to drive strong results and advertiser satisfaction.
  + Partner with campaign management, I&S, and billing teams to ensure seamless execution and accurate delivery.
  + Support monthly billing processes and maintain Salesforce updates for campaign tracking.

**Location:**

This role is hybrid and commutable to one of the following Corporate Hubs, which you must work in the office of 2 days a week (Tuesday - Wednesday):

* Boston or Wellesley, MA
* Woonsocket, RI
* New York, NY – Soho office
* Chicago, IL

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years experience in account management, media planning, digital marketing, or retail media (CPG/retail preferred), including upselling experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proven ability to lead day-to-day client relationships and collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to meet supplier needs.
* Experience developing media plan recommendations aligned with advertiser goals and performance objectives.
* Strong follow-through and accountability, ensuring seamless coordination across teams and timely execution of deliverables.

**Job Description**

Join our collaborative sales team at Thermo Fisher Scientific as a **Bioscience Account Manager (BAM)** supporting our Life Sciences research portfolio, including leading brands such as Gibco, Invitrogen, Applied Biosystems, PeproTech, eBioscience, Molecular Probes, Dynabeads, and EVOS.

Our Biosciences portfolio includes reagents, consumables, and instrumentation spanning molecular biology, protein biology, cell biology, and cell culture.

As a Bioscience Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and growing business across an assigned territory in Illinois. This is a **newly established territory**, creating an exciting opportunity to build customer relationships, develop new business, expand existing accounts, and establish a strong commercial presence across the geography.

The BAM is a key part of our commercial organization, leading customer-facing sales activities including demand generation, prospecting, account mapping, opportunity development, and closing. You will work closely with technical specialists, channel partners, and other Thermo Fisher Scientific commercial teams to connect customers with solutions that help them advance their science.

### **How will you make an impact?**

This field-based role is responsible for driving sales growth across academic, biotech, pharmaceutical, government, and other life science customers within the assigned Illinois territory.

You will develop existing business while actively identifying and creating new opportunities. Success will come through consistent customer engagement, effective prospecting, scientific and business curiosity, disciplined territory management, and strong collaboration with internal partners.

Because this is a newly established territory, the successful candidate will be energized by building a business: identifying high-potential customers, developing new customer relationships, increasing awareness of our portfolio, and converting competitive and new-account opportunities.

### **What will you do?**

* Achieve or exceed assigned sales targets by maintaining and growing existing business while developing new customers and opportunities.
* Build the newly established Illinois territory through proactive prospecting, customer outreach, account mapping, and consistent field engagement.
* Identify new-account and competitive conversion opportunities across academic, biotech, pharmaceutical, government, and other life science customers.
* Execute core sales activities including prospecting, qualification, value-based selling, opportunity development, and closing.
* Develop knowledge of customer applications and workflows to effectively position Thermo Fisher Scientific products and solutions.
* Partner with technical specialists and other internal resources to deliver product presentations, demonstrations, seminars, and customer solutions.
* Manage sales opportunities through disciplined pipeline management, including clear next steps, opportunity progression, forecasting, and close plans.
* Build strong relationships with scientists, lab managers, purchasing stakeholders, and other key customer contacts.
* Generate demand through regular customer visits, one-on-one meetings, lab engagement, scientific seminars, vendor events, and other customer-facing activities.
* Collaborate effectively with internal commercial teams, technical specialists, and distribution partners to deliver a coordinated customer experience.
* Identify competitive activity and execute strategies to win new business and gain market share.
* Participate in sales meetings, training programs, and other professional development activities.

### **Operating Cadence and Standard Work**

* Maintain a strong field presence, with customer-facing activity expected approximately **4 days per week** across the assigned Illinois territory.
* Establish a consistent operating rhythm for managing territory performance, including prospecting, funnel management, account planning, and KPI execution.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer, opportunity, and pipeline information in Salesforce to support forecasting and business visibility.
* Develop quarterly territory and account plans that identify priority customers, growth opportunities, competitive targets, and actions required to achieve revenue goals.
* Use available sales and customer data to prioritize activity and identify opportunities for growth.
* Regularly review territory performance and adjust activities to address gaps and capitalize on emerging opportunities.
* Share customer feedback, market insights, competitive intelligence, and best practices with internal partners.

### **Who are we looking for?**

* Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Biology, Life Sciences, or a related scientific field.
* **2+ years of relevant professional experience** in life sciences, laboratory research, biotechnology, scientific sales, or a related field preferred.
* Scientific knowledge and curiosity with the ability to learn customer applications, workflows, and Thermo Fisher Scientific technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships and communicate effectively with customers and internal partners.

* Self-motivated and comfortable proactively developing new customer relationships and business opportunities.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant/Office Manager
jobs.description:
**WE'RE HIRING!**

**About SyBridge Technologies**

SyBridge Technologies is a private equity-backed company specializing in advanced manufacturing, injection molding tooling, and digital manufacturing solutions. With operations across multiple locations, we are committed to innovation, operational excellence, and customer success.

  

We are seeking a hands-on, proactive, and highly organized Executive Assistant / Office Manager to support executive leadership, the Board of Directors, and the HR and Finance & Accounting departments. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes ownership of tasks from start to finish, anticipates business needs, and effectively balances executive support with daily administrative and operational responsibilities. This role requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities while ensuring accuracy, efficiency, confidentiality, and seamless coordination across departments.

  

**Position Summary**

The Executive Assistant / Office Manager provides comprehensive administrative and operational support to the CFO, EVP, Board of Directors, and HR and Finance & Accounting teams. Responsibilities include executive calendar and travel management, Board meeting coordination, office operations, legal document coordination, financial and HR administrative support, and special projects. This is an onsite role.

  

The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently with minimal direction. They must demonstrate sound judgment, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities while handling confidential financial, employee, legal, and corporate information with professionalism and discretion.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Executive & Board Support**

* Manage complex calendars, schedule meetings, coordinate appointments, and resolve scheduling conflicts for the CFO and EVP.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, itineraries, and expense reporting.
* Prepare and format executive correspondence, presentations, reports, agendas, and other business documents.
* Coordinate Board of Directors and committee meetings, including scheduling, logistics, meeting materials, and follow-up activities.
* Compile, format, and distribute confidential Board agendas, presentations, financial reports, and meeting packages.
* Maintain confidential Board records, meeting minutes, resolutions, and related documentation, as assigned.
* Coordinate meeting arrangements for Board members and senior leadership, including travel, accommodations, conference rooms, and virtual meeting access.
* Track executive commitments, deadlines, and action items to ensure timely follow-through.
* Anticipate executive needs and proactively address scheduling, logistical, and administrative issues.

  

**Office Management & Operations**

* Oversee daily office operations to maintain an organized, professional, and efficient workplace.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for office-related needs, visitors, deliveries, and general administrative inquiries.
* Coordinate office supplies, equipment, furniture, maintenance, repairs, and service requests.
* Manage relationships with office vendors, building management, and service providers, including scheduling services and tracking invoices.
* Coordinate conference room schedules, meetings, catering, and office events.
* Support employee onboarding logistics, including workspace preparation, access coordination, supplies, and other administrative arrangements.
* Assist with office expense tracking, purchase requests, and budget administration.
* Maintain office procedures, records, contact lists, and administrative documentation.

  

**HR Administrative Support**

* Provide administrative support to the HR team, including document preparation, filing, record maintenance, and reporting.
* Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding documentation, ensuring required paperwork is organized and routed appropriately.
* Maintain confidential employee files and HR documentation in accordance with established procedures.
* Coordinate employee meetings, interviews, training sessions, and HR-related communications as needed.
* Assist with tracking employee documentation, training records, and other HR administrative requirements.
* Support HR projects, employee communications, and policy distribution.
* Handle sensitive employee information with strict confidentiality and discretion.

  

**Finance & Accounting Support**

* Provide administrative support to the Finance & Accounting team, including document preparation, data entry, spreadsheet updates, and report organization.
* Assist with invoice processing, expense reports, purchase orders, and vendor documentation.
* Track invoices, payment requests, approvals, and outstanding items, escalating delays or discrepancies as appropriate.
* Organize financial records and supporting documentation for reporting, audits, and internal reviews.
* Assist with compiling financial reports, presentations, budgets, and other materials for executive review.
* Coordinate document collection and follow-up with internal stakeholders to support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end activities.
* Maintain accurate financial records and ensure documents are routed for appropriate review and approval.
* Support other Finance & Accounting administrative activities as needed.

  

**Legal & Compliance Support**

* Coordinate the review of contracts, agreements, and other business documents with internal or external legal counsel.
* Route documents for legal review, executive approval, and signature in accordance with established procedures.
* Track legal review requests, document revisions, approvals, renewal dates, and key deadlines.
* Maintain organized, confidential legal documents, corporate records, and executed agreements.

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who we Are?**

Intersection is an experience-driven Out of Home media and technology company that delivers programming, consumer amenities, and advertising to cities. From free internet access to way-finding to real-time information, our products make city life easier and more sustainable. We further enrich cities with experiential programming that inspires and engages people throughout their day. With valuable, diverse audiences in America’s top cities, we provide innovative, data-driven solutions for brands to reach urbanites at scale.

**What is the Role?**

Intersection is seeking an upbeat, energetic, and self-motivated Sales Coordinator to join the Client Success Team and work in one of our Central offices! This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented, and varied role that is perfect for someone who has experience in sales support within the media/advertising world. The ideal candidate will have outstanding interpersonal and customer service skills, have a drive to learn and the ability to perform sales support responsibilities and thrive within a team environment. Above all, this individual will provide full support to their Sales Account Executive(s), improve the sales cycles by aiding to activate new processes to ensure we live by “The Intersection Way” - maintaining a collaborative and consultative effort with our Clients.

**What you will accomplish:**

**Within your first month:**

* You will build strong relationships with your Manager, the Account Executives and Account Manager that they support
* You will onboard/train with one of the Client Success Sales Ambassadors
* You will take a deep dive into learning Intersections media and advertising offerings
* You will be a Mentee to other Sales Coordinators to learn the process and systems used within the sales support organization
* You will be exposed to all departments within Intersection and experience how they are part of the sales cycle

**Within your first three-six months:**

* You will be able to support your Account Executives/Account Managers by generating and processing contracts, proposals, and presentations that enable Intersection to scale rapidly
* You will gain exposure and have daily communication with our Clients/Agencies
* You will manage all inventory requests, inventory holds, market avails, media plans / proposals for your Account Executives/Account Managers book of business
* You will generate targeting maps and visuals for RFP responses
* You will handle invoicing requests / billing inquiries
* You will own the pre-sale lifecycle of a contract: initial market research to contract creation and execution, to artwork / specification requests, track production process
* You will research and document competitive requests
* Develop a reputation for being a solid resource and will develop the foundational knowledge of our business model and the various media products and assets
* You will be a “go-to” person who gets stuff done accurately and on time, whether it’s printing materials, setting up meetings with our clients, or building sales decks from scratch
* You will be communicating over email / by phone with internal resources (charting, ad ops, inventory, & account teams) and our Clients to ensure a smooth & positive customer service experience
* You will be a member of a great team at Intersection!

**You're a great fit for this role because:**

* You have a degree from an Accredited Institution
* You have 1-2+ years relevant work experience in a customer-facing customer success, account management or strategic consulting organization
* You can multi-task a number of different items
* You enjoy collaborating with people to get work done, but know when to take ownership of a task
* You demonstrate a high level of accountability for both your work and the work of your team
* You have strong attention to detail and can spot and fix errors
* You work fast but thoughtfully, and make suggestions for efficiencies along the way
* You have knowledge of Adobe and Microsoft Office Suite and do not mind busy work utilizing these tools for RFPs

Total Cash compensation: $50,000 - $55,000

**Hybrid Work Policy:** Our team operates on a hybrid schedule to balance flexibility with face-to-face collaboration. We require all employees to be in the office every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely the remainder of the week.

*At Intersection we celebrate every voice that makes us unique and every perspective that makes us grow. It’s our shared responsibility to create an equitable environment where every employee contributes to the culture of the company. Our products and offerings impact cities across the world and it’s our goal to represent the diversity and differences that make cities special. We will be relentless in that pursuit, because together we are better. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, nationality, citizenship status, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, domestic partnership status, civil union status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, military status/service, veteran status, mental or physical disability, and all other legally protected characteristics.*

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Lead
jobs.description:
Overview:

At AmTrust, we're focused on helping businesses thrive through specialized insurance solutions, strong distribution partnerships, and a commitment to continuous innovation. As we continue to grow, marketing plays an important role in connecting customer and partner needs with the products, services, and experiences that drive business success.

The Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager serves as a key marketing partner to assigned business, product, and functional leaders. This role helps connect business goals to marketing activities that support growth, strengthen distribution relationships, and improve customer engagement.

The ideal candidate is naturally curious and enjoys learning how the business works. They ask thoughtful questions, build strong relationships, and work collaboratively across teams to help turn business priorities into actionable marketing plans.

As part of the corporate marketing organization, this role will support a defined portfolio of products and business partners, serving as a bridge between the business unit to ensure priorities are understood, projects move forward efficiently, and marketing efforts are aligned with business unit and brand objectives.

**This role follows a hybrid work schedule and requires in-office presence four days per week in our Cleveland, Chicago, Boston, or Southington office.**

  
Responsibilities:

**What You'll Do**

**Business Partnership & Planning (50%)**

* Serve as the primary marketing contact for assigned business units, building trusted relationships with leaders across product, distribution, sales, underwriting, and other functions.
* Develop a strong understanding of business objectives, market opportunities, customer needs, and growth priorities.
* Manage the intake and progression of marketing requests and opportunities, helping stakeholders understand priorities, timelines, dependencies, and available resources.
* Support business partners in translating goals and challenges into marketing recommendations and actionable plans.
* Balance competing stakeholder needs and evaluate opportunities, recommend priorities, and help allocate marketing resources toward initiatives with the greatest potential business impact.
* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and marketing teams, ensuring priorities, requirements, and feedback are clearly communicated.
* Keep business partners informed on marketing initiatives, project status, performance, and key decisions.

**Marketing Strategy & Go-to-Market Support (30%)**

* Develop marketing briefs and recommendations that help guide campaign development and execution.
* Translate complex business, product, and underwriting concepts into clear customer, agent, and broker-focused messaging that supports marketing and go-to-market initiatives.
* Develop a working knowledge of content marketing, paid media, events, digital channels, and other marketing disciplines to effectively connect business needs with marketing solutions.
* Help ensure marketing programs are aligned with audience needs, business priorities, and desired outcomes.

**Insights & Market Understanding (10%)**

* Partner with research, analytics, and customer experience teams to better understand audience needs and behaviors.
* Gather and apply customer, market, competitor, and performance insights to support recommendations and decision-making.
* Identify trends, opportunities, and gaps that may influence marketing priorities or business performance.
* Use data and insights to evaluate opportunities and support marketing planning efforts.

**Measurement & Continuous Improvement (10%)**

* Help define success measures and support performance tracking for marketing programs and initiatives.
* Review campaign and program results to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with analytics teams to understand performance trends and support optimization efforts.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

* 5-7 years of experience in brand marketing, product marketing, communications, account management, media strategy, market research, or related discipline.
* Experience supporting the authoring of marketing plans, campaigns, go-to-market initiatives, or business-focused marketing programs.
* Ability to build strong relationships and work effectively across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a natural curiosity for understanding customers, markets, and business challenges.
* Experience working with sales, distribution, product, underwriting, or other business partners is preferred.
* Comfortable using research, data, and insights to support recommendations and decision-making.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Experience in insurance, financial services, or another complex industry is preferred.
* Familiarity with marketing analytics, CRM platforms, marketing automation, or digital marketing tools is a plus.
* Collaborative, adaptable, and willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Business partners view you as a trusted, responsive, and knowledgeable marketing partner.
* Marketing requests and projects are well-organized, communicated clearly, and executed efficiently.
* Marketing recommendations are practical, informed by business needs, and aligned with priorities.
* Go-to-market initiatives are delivered effectively and support business objectives.
* Stakeholders are aligned around clear expectations, priorities, and plans.
* Strong collaboration exists between business teams and Corporate Marketing.
* Marketing programs demonstrate measurable impact and continuous improvement.

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
Inside Sales Representative – Pharmaceuticals & Medical Supplies

We are looking for a **highly motivated, talented, and competitive Inside Sales Representative** who wants to build a substantial book of business and be rewarded directly for the results they produce.

This is not an order-taking position. We are looking for someone who is **hungry to win, comfortable prospecting for new business, persistent in developing new accounts, and motivated by uncapped earning potential.**

Our company sells **pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and medical supplies to wholesale distributors.** You will be responsible for developing your own customer base, building long-term relationships, and turning those relationships into repeat business.

What You'll Do

You will take ownership of your territory and customer base from prospecting through ongoing account management.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Prospecting and developing new B2B accounts
* Identifying purchasing decision-makers and developing relationships with them
* Selling pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to wholesale distributors
* Learning customers' purchasing patterns, product needs, and supply challenges
* Following up consistently on quotes, opportunities, and potential orders
* Growing existing accounts through repeat business and additional product opportunities
* Maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers
* Managing your sales pipeline and staying organized with follow-ups
* Working closely with our purchasing and operations teams to identify opportunities and fulfill customer needs

As you establish a strong customer base, the position becomes increasingly relationship-driven, with more of your time focused on managing, retaining, and expanding the accounts you have developed.

Who We're Looking For

We want someone with **B2B inside sales experience** who understands that building a successful book of business takes consistent effort. Medical sales experience is a plus.

The right person is:

* Competitive and highly self-motivated
* Comfortable proactively pursuing new business
* Persistent without being discouraged by rejection
* Naturally good at building business relationships
* An excellent communicator on the phone and through email
* Organized and disciplined with follow-up
* Able to identify opportunities and move quickly
* Motivated by financial success
* Interested in building something over the long term rather than simply collecting a paycheck
* Able to work independently while also contributing to a team

Experience selling pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, healthcare products, or other B2B products is valuable, but **industry experience is not required if you have demonstrated B2B sales ability and are willing to learn.**

Compensation

This position is intentionally **commission-heavy with a smaller base salary.**

We want our salespeople to have meaningful upside when they perform. Your earning potential will be driven largely by your ability to develop accounts, generate profitable sales, and grow your book of business.

**High performers will have the opportunity to earn substantially more than they would in a traditional salary-heavy sales position.**

What Success Looks Like

In the beginning, success means **activity, persistence, and account development.** You should expect to spend significant time prospecting, contacting potential customers, and creating new relationships.

Over time, the goal is to **build a valuable book of repeat customers.**

We want our salespeople developing relationships that produce repeat orders, referrals, larger opportunities, and long-term revenue.

As your customer base grows, your role will increasingly shift from pure prospecting toward **managing and expanding the relationships you've created.**

This Position Is a Great Fit If...

You are the type of salesperson who looks at a commission plan and thinks about the upside rather than the guarantee.

You enjoy competing.

You like developing relationships but aren't afraid to pursue new business.

You want your income to increase as your skills, customer base, and sales increase.

And most importantly, **you want an opportunity where exceptional performance is rewarded.**

If you're talented, hungry, persistent, and ready to build a serious book of business in the pharmaceutical and medical supply industry, we want to hear from you.

**Apply with your resume and a brief explanation of why you believe you would excel in a high-performance B2B sales environment.**

Pay: $80,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* On-the-job training
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Sales: 2 years (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* San Clemente, CA 92672 (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

**Youth Leadership Institute (yli)** brings together young people and their adult allies to create positive community change that promotes social justice and racial equity. With community-based programs based in Fresno, San Francisco, Marin, San Mateo, Merced, Long Beach and the Eastern Coachella Valley, yli engages young people of color, low-income youth, and other impacted youth as advocates of social change.

**yli CORE VALUES**

* **Inclusion**: Young people are profoundly impacted by policies affecting their communities. yli brings youth to the table and works to institutionalize youth voice in the decision-making process.
* **Innovation**: Youth can often see a way forward where adults cannot. yli encourages youth to identify and implement their own solutions to the issues their communities face.
* **Social Justice**: Throughout history, young people have ignited and led social justice movements to create a better world for everyone. yli helps them to focus their attention on the root causes of injustice, and sharpen the skills they need to tackle them.
* **Community**: Nobody can do it alone! Through relationship and coalition-building, yli feeds the connective tissue within our communities to power our movements with the brilliance, resourcefulness, and wisdom of our partners.

  

We are looking for a **Program Coordinator (PC)** in **Marin County.** The PC will work in partnership with youth (ages 12 – 24) to organize, empower and mobilize youth and their communities to win real improvements for Marin County young people.

The PC will train and support youth leaders to develop and deepen political consciousness, assess and understand issues impacting their health and well being, build relationships and partnerships with other youth and community supporters, and drive countywide and local community campaigns that create long- term systems and/or policy change, and build power for future victories.

This individual is responsible for managing all of the logistics and functional tasks necessary for meeting the goals and objectives of the assigned programs, and for ensuring that the young people are experiencing high-quality and culturally relevant leadership opportunities.

The PC will implement up to 3 school-based Friday Night Live programs (FNL). FNL is an evidence-based youth development framework to aid in the reduction of youth substance use, as well as implementing our Social Emotional Learning track through FNL. The PC will work directly in partnership with a variety of youth cohorts and adult allies to lead work that supports and leverages local efforts to amplify youth voices and create sustainable social justice change.

* Commitment to yli’s values of community, inclusion, innovation, and social justice

* Commitment to social justice, public health, and community organizing as strategies to affect change
* Experience with social media and media relations
* Demonstrated capacity to work with youth and adults from communities of color and low-income communities

This position requires in-person work in the Marin County office or in the community 4 days per week, with the option to work remotely on the 5th day.

This is a full-time non-exempt position with a rate of $27.77/hr - $30.54/hr. Compensation includes yli’s generous benefits package:

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re hiring a **Global Account Manager, Consulting & Research Agencies** to own and aggressively grow Outset’s relationships with the world’s leading **management consulting and professional services firms**.

A global consulting firm is not one customer; it’s hundreds. Strategy, customer and CX, digital and product, marketing, private equity and due diligence practices each run research for their clients—across dozens of countries, with partner-level budget owners and engagement-by-engagement buying. Firms also increasingly want to deliver AI-powered research as part of their own client offerings. HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**

We're hiring an Enterprise Customer Account Manager who will own relationships with some of our most strategic customers. You'll guide them through every stage of their journey – from adoption to expansion - driving measurable business impact and long-term success. This role blends strategy, execution, and relationship depth: you'll act as the captain for your accounts, orchestrating internal and customer teams, solving challenges, and ensuring every customer achieves tangible outcomes with HackerRank.

We're seeking candidates based in a major metro area with convenient access to a major airport. Preferred locations include the **San Francisco Bay Area, New York City, Los Angeles, and Seattle**.

Candidates based in the **San Francisco Bay Area or New York City are required to follow a hybrid schedule**. Candidates based in Los Angeles or Seattle may work remotely.

#### **What you'll do**

* Maintain full functional and process knowledge of HackerRank products and services as well as market awareness and knowledge of competitive threats.
* Own and manage your Book of Business (BoB) - driving adoption, retention, and expansion across enterprise customers through deep partnership and measurable outcomes.
* Develop and execute account strategies that connect customer objectives with HackerRank's mission, ensuring long-term value realization and growth.
* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and technical leaders, embedding HackerRank into their hiring and workforce planning.
* Act as the captain for your accounts – leading internal and customer teams, resolving blockers, and accelerating time-to-value.
* Run proactive engagement cadences including QBRs, success check-ins, and executive reviews.
* Structure mutually beneficial commercial terms that promote long-term growth and customer success, balancing value realization with business expansion.
* Maintain accurate forecasts, health metrics, and growth pipelines while ensuring seamless handoffs and transparent reporting.

#### **Who you are**

* Bring 5+ years of Saas enterprise account management, ideally in fast-scaling environments.
* Known for your grit and curiosity, you stay resilient through challenges while constantly seeking to understand your customers' goals, industry shifts, and opportunities to create value.
* Naturally relationship-oriented, you build trust and credibility with Fortune 500 customers, becoming a long-term advisor who drives both strategic and measurable outcomes.
* A strong communicator and collaborator, you simplify complex ideas, engage confidently across audiences, and bring your customer and internal teams together around shared goals.
* Deeply expert in your craft, you combine product mastery with a keen sense of business impact, connecting HackerRank's platform to customer value.
* Highly organized and outcome-driven, you manage multiple enterprise accounts with precision – balancing structure, transparency, and consistent delivery.

#### **Even better if you have**

* Experience working with HR tech or developer ecosystems, especially within enterprise-scale organizations.
* A background in driving multi-product adoption or leading high-growth, customer-centric initiatives.
* Comfort navigating cross-functional complexity to align internal teams and deliver unified customer outcomes.

#### **You will thrive in this role if**

* You act like a captain, owning outcomes end-to-end and thriving in fast-moving, high-accountability environments.
* Building long-term partnerships energizes you more than short-term wins.
* You balance empathy with execution - understanding customer pain points while driving tangible business results.
* Excellence, speed, and impact are non-negotiable for you - not trade-offs.

#### **Compensation**

This sales role is eligible for incentive-based pay, with an annual total potential earnings range of $200,000 to $250,000, including base salary and incentive-based compensation (based on quota attainment).

**Want to learn more about HackerRank?** Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.

HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Galileo Learning’s mission is to develop innovators who envision and create a better world.

We provide out-of-school enrichment programs that build innovation skills, growth mindset, and creative confidence across a variety of offerings. We run neighborhood summer day camps for families, deliver expanded learning programs for school districts, and empower educational institutions and service providers with curriculum and instructional support.

We are:

* Visionary: We think beyond what exists today and work toward what’s possible.
* Courageous: We take ownership, make decisions with imperfect information, and lean into challenges.
* Collaborative: We work across teams and perspectives, assuming positive intent and building strong partnerships.
* Determined: We follow through, hold a high bar for quality, and stay focused on delivering results that matter for our students and partners

* 2+ years of professional experience in high-volume sales, outreach, or customer-facing role

* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to craft clear, compelling messages

San Francisco Bay Area preferred: Employees located in the San Francisco Bay Area adhere to a hybrid office and work-from-home policy. Galileo Headquarters is located at 111 Myrtle St, Ste 300, Oakland, CA 94607.

Remote, work-from-home, location is possible in the following states: California, Colorado, Illinois, Massachusetts, Texas, North Carolina, New York, or Washington.

This is a full-time position, averaging 40 hours per week. While we prioritize work-life balance, there may be times when additional hours are necessary to meet deadlines and ensure the success of our programs. **About PolicyLift**
--------------------

PolicyLift is the AI-native growth engine for independent P&C agencies: one platform that drives growth, consolidates fragments of point solutions, so agencies can source and close premium faster. Our team brings experiences from top-tier technology companies like Google, Meta, and Insurtech leaders like Qualia.

PolicyLift is VC-backed used by 1,000+ agents and actively services a book of over $1B in premium.

**About the Role**
------------------

You’re a former independent P&C agent who has quoted, bound, serviced and renewed policies. Now you'll draw on that experience to help build and implement technology that helps agents win more premium.

PolicyLift services a book of over $1B in premium, and we're adding agencies faster every month. This role is the person who helps get new agencies live, keeps their team unstuck, and brings the agent's point of view into what our team builds next. It's a hybrid of three things: product, onboarding, and ongoing agency success.

Customers listen to you because you've done their job. Our engineers listen to you for the same reason. You provide deep industry experience to solve real pain points at independent agencies.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

PolicyLift does four jobs for independent P&C agencies:

* **Grow.** Website, SEO, AI search and email marketing that bring in leads.
* **Intake.** AI agents, smart forms, and carrier data and documents, so every lead is captured and complete.
* **Submit.** One-click transfer to the systems that matter: AMS, CRM, raters and carriers.
* **Bind.** Comparisons and proposals that get the policy bound.

Every one of those touches the details agents care about: which carrier for which risk, what an HO-5 covers that an HO-3 doesn’t, how a BOP submission differs from a package. Agencies trust us with that work. The person who onboards them, trains their CSRs, and brings their feedback to our roadmap should speak their language fluently.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Insurance Workflow Expertise**

* Work directly with the leadership team on representing the independent agent, informing what we build, in what order, and what "done right" means for an agent.
* Turn real agency scenarios into the standard we build and measure against: the personal lines and commercial lines cases every release has to get right.
* Review new workflows, integrations, and automations before they ship, from the agent's seat.
* Stay up to date on key agency technology such as AMS, raters, intake tools, carrier portals and download feeds our customers depend on, and where PolicyLift fits in each.
* Participate in the industry by visiting agencies in person, attend conferences, and user groups as PolicyLift's most credible voice.

**Onboarding and Implementation**

* Help get new agencies live on PolicyLift.
* Learn how each agency handles intake, quoting, submissions, renewals and servicing, and configure PolicyLift to match.
* Map each agency's stack (AMS, raters, carriers, CSR handoffs) and wire PolicyLift into it.
* Train their team, from a two-person office to a 30-person agency rollout, and hand off a healthy account to our customer success lead.
* Build quick-reference guides, onboarding checklists, role-based training paths and adoption playbooks, and turn one agency's wins into resources every agency gets.

**Support**

* Be the first call when an agency hits something insurance-specific: a quote that doesn't look right, a carrier question, a workflow the AI should handle differently.
* Reproduce, document and triage issues before escalating to engineering, then follow them through to resolution.
* Help drive adoption early (low usage, reverted workflows, a CSR who went back to the old way) and fix the root cause: retraining, a workflow change, or a product request.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A former (or current) agent.** You hold or recently held a P&C license, and you've spent 3+ years in an independent agency as a producer, or account manager
* **Fluent in personal and commercial lines.** You can explain HO-3 vs. HO-5, when an umbrella makes sense, BOP vs. package, GL class codes, experience mods and commercial auto symbols without looking them up.
* **Hands-on with agency tech.** You've lived inside an AMS, run comparative raters, worked carrier portals and download feeds.
* **A process builder.** You see the whole process from lead to renewal, not just the next task, and you notice where it breaks before you get there.
* **Bilingual: insurance agent and product specialist.** You can earn an agency owner's trust in the morning and walk an engineer through an edge case in the afternoon.
* **Curious about AI.** You don't need to write code. You do need to want to understand how the product works and help it get better.

**Bonus qualifications**
------------------------

* You've owned or run an agency, managed a personal/commercial lines team of producers, or managed a service team.
* Designations such as CIC, CISR, CPCU or AINS.
* You've led an AMS or rater migration or implementation.
* You've tried AI tools in your agency and know where they fall short.
* Any product or tech-adjacent experience.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity
* Fully covered health, dental and vision (full-time only).
* A fast-track to promotion in Product, Customer Success, or Support
* A direct line to leadership: your feedback turns into real product insights

* A front-row seat at an early-stage AI company that respects what agents actually do.
* An opportunity to bring your insurance expertise into a leading AI platform for insurance.

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations.
